state_invariants.identity_rule: Steven Adams identity must be locked/tracked per camera before cross-view geometry is used. Geometry may not silently select another player.
state_invariants.temporal_rule: No per-joint temporal mixing. Each camera observation in a tested triplet must come from one real native decoded frame.
state_invariants.geometry_rule: Camera physical centres are calibration anchors and must not be optimized from player or ball residuals.
state_invariants.quality_rule: Native source first; no upscaling; no generated RGB; no interpolation or blur/crossfade to hide a failed state match.
state_invariants.gate_rule: Existing exact-state and reprojection thresholds may be retained or tightened but not weakened merely to obtain a pass.
